headline: Board to review personnel changes, probationary teacher hires, and a first read on the Fiscal Year 2027 budget update.
summary: The meeting covers personnel resignations, terminations, and hires, plus election of probationary teacher candidates. The board will also hear fall department presentations and take a first read on the Fiscal Year 2027 budget, then enter executive session to discuss a personnel matter.
items: Board Chair remarks and Superintendent SY26-27 goals
Review of personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, other hires
Student, Family and Community Partnership presentation
Immigration Support: SW Family Partnership presentation
Approve personnel items: election of probationary teacher candidates
First read on Fiscal Year 2027 Budget Update
Enter Executive Session under 1 M.R.S.A. § 405(6)(D) to discuss a personnel matter
location: Casco Bay High School and via Zoom
